annotations.text: All three pages load data client-side via SQL against a Parquet file (DuckDB-WASM) - no server round trip. Main and Insights have a "Loading state" tweak above the artboard: toggle it to see the skeleton-shimmer state that should show while the query resolves, before fading up into the real content (reuses the existing fadeUp keyframe already in production CSS).

Real data for 13thjudicialil.gov. Added a status strip under the header for at-a-glance scanning - status/HTTPS/blocking/TLS expiry - before the reader has to parse the full field-grid. Single-domain lookups are fast enough that a skeleton flash (not shown as a toggle here) should be brief, not a stall.

New page - the old insights.html was retired when Explore's facets replaced it. Reuses the exact facet-row/track/fill visual language from Explore for consistency rather than introducing chart components. Real breakdown data from the current snapshot.
